## Description
Please include a summary of the changes and which issue/feature they address.

## Type of Change
- [ ] feat (new feature)
- [ ] fix (bug fix)
- [ ] refactor (refactoring logic)
- [ ] docs (documentation updates)
- [ ] style (formatting, layout updates)

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the code style and naming conventions of this project.
- [ ] I have verified database migrations (if applicable).
- [ ] Zod schema validation is implemented for all inputs.
- [ ] RBAC authorization checks are enforced on endpoints.
- [ ] Standard success/error envelopes are used.
- [ ] UI is responsive and accessible.
- [ ] I have run local builds and tests.
